We offer classes in several methods at MKG Seattle including Savate, Jun Fan / Jeet Kune Do, STX, boxing, and even fitness classes, but Muay Thai training is by far the most popular. Learn more below. Designed to accommodate students of all levels, the emphasis is to keep moving, learn the real art, have fun and get a great workout
